summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Google Maps Location Scraper. All backend APIs working correctly with Google Places integration. Frontend fully functional with category selection, search, results display, and CSV export.

ui_bugs.issue: Emergent badge overlay intercepts pointer events, requiring force=True to click
ui_bugs.workaround: Button works with force click, functionality is intact

passed_tests: Backend API /api/places/search works with Google Places API
Frontend loads with category dropdown showing 5 options
Search functionality works end-to-end (tested foodie and thrill_seeking)
Results display in grid with location cards (46 foodie, 45 thrill_seeking locations)
CSV export button appears when results exist
CSV export functionality works (with force click)
Invalid category search returns proper 400 error
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor UI fix: Remove or adjust z-index of Emergent badge to prevent interference with CSV export button clicks
